neighbours.label: a split word stem (mater-, soc-, partic-, financ-) whose next piece is a French-style ending (-iel, -iaux, -ule) rather than English -ial; the output suppresses 'ial' and 'ular'
fire: Convoys carried troops and materiel across the river every night for a week.
Les services sociaux de la ville manquent de personnel depuis des années.
Chaque particule de poussière brille dans la lumière du matin.
The treaty limited how much war materiel each side could keep near the border.
Les réseaux sociaux ont changé la façon dont les jeunes s'informent.
Une particule chargée suit une trajectoire courbe dans ce champ.
Les marchés financiers ont réagi avec calme à cette annonce.
Most of the captured materiel was old and of little use to the rebels.
quiet: Convoys carried troops and material across the river every night for a week.
The social services of the city have been short of staff for years.
Each particle of dust shines in the morning light.
The treaty limited how much war equipment each side could keep near the border.
Les jeunes de la ville ont changé la façon dont ils voyagent.
Une petite voiture suit une route courbe dans ce village.
The financial markets reacted calmly to this announcement.
Most of the captured material was old and of little use to the rebels.

notes: Card: 'ic' x7, ' soc' x4, 'ent' x4, ' financ' x3, ' mater' x2 before French or unusual endings (materiel, sociaux, particule); logit effect suppresses 'ial', 'ular', 'IAL'. Probe: materiel 0.74, sociaux 0.61, particule 0.50; English material 0.01, social / financial 0.01, commercials 0.00, beneficiary / fiduciary 0.01.
